descriptions: Warp Surge is here
Defeat <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units, gain <style="HSE_Points_WarpSurge">Warp Surge Points</style> and claim exclusive rewards!

During the event, <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> characters earn more XP from Arena battles based on their rarity:
<nobr><style=Rarity_Common>Common: {[MODIFIER_Common]}x XP</style></nobr> <nobr><voffset=0.3em>.</voffset> <style=Rarity_Uncommon>Uncommon: {[MODIFIER_Uncommon]}x XP</style></nobr> <nobr><voffset=0.3em>.</voffset> <style=Rarity_Rare>Rare: {[MODIFIER_Rare]}x XP</style></nobr> <nobr><voffset=0.3em>.</voffset> <style=Rarity_Epic>Epic: {[MODIFIER_Epic]}x XP</style></nobr> <nobr><voffset=0.3em>.</voffset> <style=Rarity_Legendary>Legendary: {[MODIFIER_Legendary]}x XP</style></nobr> <nobr><voffset=0.3em>.</voffset> <style=Rarity_Mythic>Mythic: {[MODIFIER_Mythic]}x XP</style></nobr>
Arena battles also start with {[nrOfUnits]} random <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> on each side.
All <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> characters in Arena have +{[healthPct]}% Health, +{[dmgPct]}% Damage, and +{[armorPct]}% Armour.
You gain <style="HSE_Points_WarpSurge">{[POINTS]} Warp Surge Points</style> for each enemy <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> unit that you defeat, except <style="Summon">Summons</style>.
Raiding a battle counts as having defeated all enemies.
